baseline_exact_head.economic_interpretation: Non-hard shadow/theory output only; no PAPER fill-conditioned PnL claim.

defect.name: freshness_gate_required_non_executable_complement_tokens
defect.description: The freshness layer required both YES and NO tokens for every market appearing in a multi-leg opportunity, even when the executable basket used only one of those outcomes. In particular, NegRisk complete-set pricing buys only each member YES token, but evaluate_event_locked required every member YES and NO token to have current full-WS lineage. NegRisk conversions and logical relations were similarly gated on broader token sets than their priced/executable legs. Publish-time revalidation repeated the same over-requirement by expanding every opportunity leg back to both market outcomes.
defect.why_it_matters: With only 11.13% of tokens carrying valid full-WS lineage at the end of the baseline exact-head run, requiring irrelevant complementary tokens can reject otherwise synchronized executable baskets. This is a structural zero-hard-hit mechanism, not evidence that quoted hard-arbitrage edge is absent.
defect.safety: The repair does not relax the 5s per-leg age bound or 1.5s cross-leg exchange/receive skew. It narrows the freshness set to exactly the books that enter the executable basket.

contracts: Binary complete-set still requires YES+NO freshness.
NegRisk complete-set requires only the YES tokens actually bought.
Each NegRisk conversion requires source NO plus target YES tokens actually used.
Implication requires antecedent NO plus consequent YES only.
Mutual exclusion requires the two NO legs only.
Exhaustive pair requires the two YES legs only.
Publish-time revalidation uses opportunity.legs token ids exactly.
All existing per-leg age/skew and reconnect/full-WS lineage guards remain unchanged.

required_next_evidence: Exact-head deterministic CI and Research Policy green.
Exact-head Fast Shadow on public data.
Compare missing/age/skew rejection counts and hard-hit recall against the baseline above.
Any hard hit must still pass authoritative fee, multi-level depth, exact per-leg clocks, sequential PAPER legging/partial/unwind and canonical-ledger realized PnL gates before any alpha claim.
